findings.title: Invalid [updates] owner_repo returns before recordCheckDate, so the check stays due and the loop wakes every 60 s instead of daily
findings.evidence: check() early-returns on an invalid owner_repo before recording the attempt (raised by Nemesis, remediation B17)
findings.fix: Record the attempt date (or back off to the next day) on a config error
findings.impact: 60 s wake-ups with status reset to failed; no network traffic
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B17

findings.title: SDD-auto-update-checker still states the old minimum-24 h rule and the invariant never check within 24 h
findings.evidence: The calendar-day rule of UPDATE-SCHED-001 intentionally breaks that invariant (raised by Jano, remediation B17)
findings.fix: Update the SDD to the calendar-day rule with a pointer to UPDATE-SCHED-001
findings.impact: Someone could restore the 24 h floor from the spec
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B17

findings.title: Minimum update-retry floor applied both in delayUntilNextCheck and again in the loop
findings.evidence: max(minimumRetryDelay, delay) repeated (raised by Higia, remediation B17)
findings.fix: Have the instance delay return the floored value
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B17

findings.title: update_loop_not_started_when_disabled proves absence with 5 Task.yield() calls
findings.evidence: Weak negative proof; guard is synchronous (raised by Higia, remediation B17)
findings.fix: Assert on the loop task handle being nil instead
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B17
